source: Wellmann (ed.), Pedanii Dioscuridis Anazarbei De materia medica, Berlin: Weidmann 1906-1914; Internet Archive scans b21459162_0001/_0002/_0003 (University of Glasgow Library, sponsor Jisc and Wellcome Library)
licence_verified: Internet Archive rights statement on all three items: 'Copyright Not Evaluated' (rightsstatements.org/vocab/CNE/1.0/), NOT a public-domain mark. Underlying work: Max Wellmann (1863-1933, d. 9 Oct 1933 per de.wikisource) -> life+70 expired end of 2003 (EU/DE); pre-1929 publication -> PD in US. So the 1906-1914 edition is PD by our own analysis, but the archive does not assert it.
attribution: No attribution required by the archive. Scholarly citation: Wellmann M. (ed.) 1906-1914. Pedanii Dioscuridis Anazarbei De materia medica libri quinque. 3 vols. Berlin: Weidmann. Digitised by University of Glasgow Library (Internet Archive b21459162_0001-0003).

difference_note: Wellmann's death date is 1933, not 1922 (archive metadata and de.wikisource both give 1863-1933). The PD conclusion still holds (EU term expired 2003; US pre-1929), but the table's rationale is wrong and the archive items carry 'Copyright Not Evaluated', not a PD statement. Fix the rationale text.

source: WorldClim 2.1 (worldclim.org), historical 1970-2000 and CMIP6 downscaled futures
licence_verified: WorldClim About page: 'The data are freely available for academic use and other non-commercial use. Redistribution or commercial use is not allowed without prior permission.' Maps from the data may be published in academic research articles. No CC licence. Future data page links CMIP6 terms (pcmdi.llnl.gov): CMIP6 output licences vary by model (page template cites CC BY-SA 4.0; some groups use CC BY-NC-SA 4.0); check each netCDF 'license' attribute.
attribution: Historical: 'Fick, S.E. and R.J. Hijmans, 2017. WorldClim 2: new 1km spatial resolution climate surfaces for global land areas. International Journal of Climatology 37 (12): 4302-4315.' Future: WorldClim's page gives no separate citation, only links CMIP6 terms, which require: acknowledge the World Climate Research Programme, the modelling groups, ESGF and funders; cite CMIP6 GMD overview paper(s) and the specific model output per the CMIP6 Data Citation Guidelines; include a table of source_id/institution_id for the GCMs used.
restrictions: Non-commercial/academic only. NO redistribution without prior permission (contact info@worldclim.org). Do not re-host raw or clipped WorldClim rasters in the repo/site. difference_note: DIFFERENCE: the table said 'free for research; cite Fick & Hijmans 2017'. The actual terms also forbid redistribution without permission, and future CMIP6 data need extra CMIP6/WCRP/ESGF acknowledgement plus model citations (Fick & Hijmans alone is not enough). Decide: do not commit WorldClim rasters (pipeline downloads them), and ask WorldClim whether publishing derived risk layers on a public website is OK.

licence_verified: ODbL 1.0 (Geofabrik: 'All OpenStreetMap derived data on the download server is licensed under the Open Database License 1.0'; osm.org/copyright).
attribution: 'OpenStreetMap' linked to https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright (historical '© OpenStreetMap contributors' still acceptable), plus a note that the data is available under the ODbL. For data products: attribution plus ODbL text/link in README or metadata.
restrictions: Our 2 km road/settlement-distance mask is a Derivative Database (ODbL s.1). Internal use is not public use (s.4.5). Published 10 km risk cells are, at most, a Produced Work from that derivative database, so: (a) s.4.3: publicly used Produced Work needs a notice that it derives from OSM and that OSM is ODbL; (b) s.4.6: when a Produced Work from a Derivative Database is publicly used, we must offer the derivative database OR 'a file containing all of the alterations... or the algorithm used to make them', free online. The published reproducible pipeline (mask-building code) should meet this; keep that code public. Share-alike (s.4.4) applies to the mask only if we publish the mask itself. The OSMF guidelines do not address whether aggregated grid statistics are Produced Works; the Produced Work guideline says a result meant for extracting the original data is a database.
difference_note: Licence matches (ODbL). Obligations to note: Produced Work notice on site/README, and the s.4.6 method-disclosure duty (met by publishing the pipeline). Do not publish the 2 km mask unless it goes out under ODbL.
